$comment: The verified mapping for the connected ambientui design file, updated after each sync. Procedure: figma/figma-sync.md. Collections are what the file ACTUALLY holds, confirmed by read-back 2026-08-27.

Palette.role: Tailwind color ramps verbatim ({family}/{50..950}) - primitives, never bend to the config, deliberately NO code syntax (raw steps are illegal in component code)

Foundation.role: aliases only - ~20 color roles into Palette, Radius/xs..4xl + Radius/Active into Tailwind Primitives, Type/xs..4xl, Spacing/Unit, Scale/Root font size + Scale/Factor. Components bind THESE.

Tailwind Primitives.role: nominal scales verbatim: border radius/rounded-*, gap/gap-*, padding/p-*, font size/text-* - code syntax is the utility class (p-4, rounded-lg)

Typography.role: font family only (Geist); weights are Figma style names and deliberately not synced
